t: Strong and reliable, heavy duty picture hooks made from high-quality, rust-resistant steel and zinc. For dependable use when hanging heavy pictures, frames and canvas onto masonry walls, timber and plasterboard (when used with Bullfix Plasterboard Fixings: sold separately). Features reliable safety clips. Easy to install in 5 simple steps. Kit includes fixings, screws and masonry plugs.
b: Contents: Hooks & Clips (10), Screws (10) & Masonry Plugs (10)
Can Be Used In Plasterboard With Bullfix Universal Fixings (Sold Separately)
Safety Clip Keeps Mirror Or Picture In Place
Wall Hooks For Pictures Or Mirrors
